Subject: NextWave POC: success matrix & operational owners (post-demo)

Hi Olivia — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have alignment before the POC kickoff.

Recap of discovery
- Primary use case: extractive Q&A over customer support transcripts + smart summarization for agent assistants.
- Expected peak traffic pattern: batch ingestion of 10k transcripts/day with real-time per-conversation inference for new tickets (~3–5 TPS average across 10 concurrent agent workspaces).
- Data residency: US-only, S3 staging acceptable; security questionnaire required.

Proposed POC scope (2-week technical trial)
1) Baseline evaluation: run our sample prompt set over a representative slice you provide (~1k prompts) to measure: latency (p95/p99), throughput (requests/sec), cost per token, and quality (exact-match + human-rated precision).
2) Operational test: simulate steady-state agent traffic (50 req/min sustained for 1 hour) to validate batching/throughput and KV/cache behavior.
3) Regression monitoring: define 6 golden prompts to track hallucination and answer accuracy during the POC.

Success criteria (draft)
- Latency: p95 <= 150ms, p99 <= 400ms for 512-token responses
- Throughput: sustain 60 req/s for 60s without queue growth
- Cost: average inference cost <= $0.0009 per token (token accounting on our side)
- Quality: automated accuracy >= 85% on the sample prompt set; hallucination incidents <= 2% (human-reviewed)

Owners / roles
- Redwood: Hannah (engagement lead), Ben (technical contact, benchmarking & runbook), Marissa (CS, onboarding & quality review)
- NextWave: Olivia (product owner), Michael (legal / procurement)

Attachments: I attached a trial success matrix template and a small sample prompt set we typically use. Can you confirm the data slice you'll use for the baseline? Also share any IP/processing constraints your security team expects.

If that looks good I can send a mutual action plan and a calendar invite for a short kickoff next Tuesday (11/10).

Thanks — Hannah

Hi Olivia — hi Hannah, adding a couple technical clarifications and what we'll run for the baseline so expectations are set.

What Redwood will measure (bench plan)
- End-to-end request latency (client to model response) including tokenization & network hops
- Model throughput under two modes: low-latency single-request and batched bulk-run for offline summarization
- Cost per token computed from our runtime billing (we'll provide token counts + cost breakdown)
- Quality metrics: exact-match for extractive Q&A, ROUGE-L for summarization + a 50-sample human quality audit

Test config (draft)
- Model family: open-verified Llama-2-ish variant (we'll propose 13B quantized)
- Context: 512 tokens baseline; we can test 1024 in round 2 if needed
- Load sim: 60 req/s for 60s, 10-minute ramp, 5-minute cool-down

Deliverables during POC
- Bench report with p50/p95/p99, throughput graphs, per-route cost table, and quality audit notes
- Quick ops playbook: how to map your traffic patterns to batching/cache knobs to hit cost/latency targets

Attachments: I uploaded a sample prompt set we plan to run and a short run command example in the attached JSONL.

Ben
